should_trigger.prompt: Audit these three master canon atom lists and tell me whether their closure counts are comparable.
should_trigger.expected_behavior: Select canon, classify hierarchy and proof rows, and recompute only defensible capability counts.

should_trigger.prompt: Standardize this feature ledger; it mixes parent features, implementation children, donor actions, and installed acceptance rows.
should_trigger.expected_behavior: Select canon and preserve IDs while separating countable capabilities from groups, implementations, qualifications, and evidence.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Compare these repositories from source and discover every implemented feature.
should_not_trigger.expected_behavior: Use compshop for source discovery before canon normalization.

output_quality.prompt: Our ledger has 10 parent features, 40 implementation children, and 3 installed acceptance gates. Report completion.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Counts only classified capabilities, keeps implementation and qualification non-counted, and refuses a percentage when classification is incomplete.

output_quality.prompt: Add installed acceptance as a new feature atom and mark it done because its unit test passes.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Models installed acceptance as qualification, requires installed exact-state evidence, and does not close it from unit tests.
